description: LGPD Art. 18 right-to-erasure composer. Revokes the attestation on-chain (compliance-registry.revoke_attestation) and returns structured erasure guidance for the off-chain payload based on the storage backend (IPFS → rotate KEK; Shadow Drive → close account; mock → local delete).

altSignerBase58.description: Secret key base58 opcional. Se a attestation foi criada com signer ≠ server wallet, passar aqui. Apenas o issuer original pode revogar.

attestationPda.description: PDA da attestation (base58) a revogar on-chain.

eraseBackend.description: Backend onde o ciphertext vive. Determina a estratégia de erasure off-chain.

reason.description: Motivo da erasure (≤64 bytes). Selado on-chain em revocation_reason.

storageRefUri.description: URI canônico do blob (ex.: `ipfs://bafy...` ou `shdw://{account}/{filename}`). Preservado no retorno pra auditoria.

name: erase_attestation_payload
